name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: In Westfall, the People's Militia seeks the Defias Brotherhood's hidden base. A captured brigand will guide you there in exchange for protection, leading through Moonbrook to Edwin VanCleef's inner sanctum.

sections.title: A Turncoat's Bargain
sections.body: The Defias Traitor fears execution or assassination by his former brothers. So he bargains with the People's Militia: escort him safely through hostile territory, and he will reveal where Edwin VanCleef and his ringleaders hide. The thieves' network silences those who speak out, and the turncoat needs armed protection along the road.

sections.title: The Road Through Moonbrook
sections.body: The traitor leads you southwest from Sentinel Hill into Moonbrook, a township overrun by the Brotherhood. He guides you past the abandoned town square and fountain, drawing the anger of brigands, looters, and highwaymen who patrol the ruins. Then he leads you to the entrance of the sprawling Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, where VanCleef has fortified an underground stronghold.

faq.answer: The Defias Traitor is a former member of the Brotherhood who became an informant for Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia. Fearing death at his former comrades' hands, he traded the location of Edwin VanCleef's underground redoubt for an escort to safety.

faq.q: Where does the traitor lead you?
faq.answer: He leads you southwest from Sentinel Hill into Moonbrook, past the ruined town square and fountain, to the Deadmines entrance beneath the town.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle need this information?
aliases: why do we escort the traitor
faq.answer: The People's Militia has fought highwaymen across Westfall without knowing where Edwin VanCleef directs operations. Finding the entrance to his underground lair gives the militia a clear target at the heart of the rebellion.

faq.q: Why is Moonbrook crawling with Defias?
aliases: why are there defias in moonbrook
faq.answer: Moonbrook was once a thriving agricultural center, but the Kingdom of Stormwind fell into neglect and bandits moved in. Its residents abandoned the town, and the Defias Brotherhood claimed its empty buildings as an above-ground perimeter guarding the Deadmines entrance.

faq.q: What happens after you discover the hideout?
faq.answer: After the traitor reveals the Deadmines entrance, you report to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill. With proof of VanCleef's location, the militia prepares a direct assault on the underground lair.

faq.q: Why does the Brotherhood want the traitor dead?
faq.answer: The Defias rely on secrecy, hiding in tunnels while directing operations throughout Stormwind's territories. A turncoat who reveals the entrance to their central operation threatens to unravel their conspiracy.

angles.text: For the embattled People's Militia, finding the hideout is a major military breakthrough and their first real chance to strike a decisive blow against Westfall's criminal insurgency.
As a rogue, you know the price of betrayal in the criminal underworld, where broken vows are answered with daggers.
As a human of Stormwind, you see Moonbrook fallen to lawlessness and occupied by former Stonemasons. It shows how deeply the kingdom has fractured since the Third War.
